# Project: Compute a Student's Grade

#### Course: Learn C Programming

## Project: Compute a Student's Grade

```c
1#include <stdio.h>
2
3// Find the average score and return it
4double getAverageScore(double scores[5]) {
5
6  double sum = 0;
7
8  // find the sum
9  for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
10    sum = sum + scores[i];
11  }
12
13  double average = sum / 5;
14
15  return average;
16}
17
18// Compute grade and return it
19char computeGrade(double averageScore) {
20
21  char grade;
22  
23  if (averageScore >= 80.0) {
24    grade = 'A';
25  }
26  else if (averageScore >= 60.0) {
27    grade = 'B';
28  }
29  else if (averageScore >= 50.0) {
30    grade = 'C';
31  }
32  else {
33    grade = 'F';
34  }
35
36  return grade;
37}
38
39int main() {
40
41  // An array of scores
42  double scores[5] = {55, 64, 75, 80, 65};
43
44  // Get average score
45  double averageScore = getAverageScore(scores);
46
47  // Get grade
48  char grade = computeGrade(averageScore);
49
50  printf("Average Score: %.2lf\n", averageScore);
51  printf("Grade: %c", grade);
52
53  return 0;
54}
```

Output

```text
Average Score: 67.80
Grade: B
```

Here,

- We have used the getAverageScore() function to first calculate the average score.
- Then, we passed the average score as an argument to the computeGrade() function to compute the grade.

In this program, we have provided student scores directly at the beginning.

We can make this program dynamic by getting marks input from the user.

I suggest you try that on your own.
